svg.title: Weight resolved into components on an incline
svg.desc: On an incline at angle θ, the weight w is split into w∥ = w sin θ = mg sin θ down the slope and w⊥ = w cos θ = mg cos θ into the slope. The tilted axes have x along the incline and y perpendicular to it; the angle between w and w⊥ is θ. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Changing the incline changes the components, not the weight
Angle sweep 10° → 60° with weight fixed at 100 N. All vectors share one scale. Components add to the
vertical weight; the point marks their common origin, not a sliding block.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
